shadows.name: structural-float
shadows.purpose: Menus and drawers that overlap scrolling content.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, selection, and compact disclosure.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a local task region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #155F75; color: #fff; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0E4C5E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #087EA4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0B3E4D; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #C8D3D7; color: #4B5C63; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action with structural emphasis only.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #152126; min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; border: 1px solid #C8D3D7; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #EAF0F2; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #087EA4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #DDE6E9; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #152126; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #C8D3D7; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #152126; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #4B5C63; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #81939A; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #087EA4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact state label that never relies on color alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #DDF1E7; color: #13583C; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Queue Navigation Item
components.description: A selected queue row with state, subject, and age.
components.css: .ds-queue-item { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #E1F1F4; color: #152126; text-align: left; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-queue-item small { color: #4B5C63; font-weight: 400; } .ds-queue-item:hover { background: #D3E9ED; } .ds-queue-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #087EA4; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Staff use cueq in bright university offices and quieter after-hours operations, reviewing sensitive queues where a wrong action has payroll, legal, or privacy consequences. The interface is light-first, compact, and materially quiet, with an equally complete dark theme.
keyCharacteristics: German-first labels with exact English parity.
Solid cool-neutral surfaces with one restrained civic accent.
Complete state vocabulary across light, dark, desktop, and mobile layouts.

rules.name: The One Civic Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent marks an actionable or selected state. It never fills dashboards for atmosphere.

rules.name: The Operational Scale Rule
rules.body: Product headings use a fixed rem scale. No fluid hero typography, display font, or tracked uppercase eyebrow is permitted.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface does not overlap other content, it does not receive a shadow.

dos: Do show permission, current state, prerequisites, freshness, and the next valid action in the main reading order.
Do use 8–12px surface radii, solid tonal layers, subtle borders, and 150–250ms state motion with a reduced-motion alternative.
Do omit unauthorized controls and pair authorized-but-invalid disabled controls with an adjacent explanation.
donts: Don't use SaaS gamification, competitive productivity scores, surveillance metrics, or attention-seeking dashboards.
Don't use marketing hero layouts, oversized metric cards, action clutter, or decorative empty space that buries evidence.
Don't use glassmorphism, blur, gradients, gradient text, broad ambient shadows, oversized radii, bounce motion, or decorative animation.
